character.retiredNote: The capybara mascot was replaced by the brand kit's two characters (see "characters" below). Every ad made with it shows the old mascot and must be remade before it runs again. Kept only as the record of what the existing ads used; do not generate anything new from it.
character.name: Capi
character.role: Credalti's AI assistant, shown in ads as a capybara in work clothes
character.look: A real animal filmed on location, not a cartoon: true capybara head with a long blunt muzzle, dark leathery nose, small natural dark brown eyes that are open, bright and alert, small ears, coarse reddish-brown fur with individual strands, real whiskers, two ivory front teeth visible when he speaks.
character.wardrobe: Plain navy cap with no text, small black headset with a boom microphone, navy short-sleeve work shirt, dusty navy denim overalls, brown work boots.
character.scale: Stands upright, exactly 3 feet tall: the top of his cap reaches an adult's belt line.
character.manner: Calm, warm, deadpan. Never frantic, never cartoonish.
never: cartoon, 3D animated movie character, Pixar style, plush toy or costume
oversized glossy eyes, sleepy or squinting eyes
text, logos or lettering on the cap or clothing
phones in hands, license plate text

characters.source: Owner's brand kit (2026-11-21), web-ready folder: transparent WebP at @1x and @2x.
characters.rule: Locked art: never edit, redraw, recolour, re-crop or regenerate the characters. Place them on navy or ivory/white; on very dark or saturated backgrounds a light 1-2 px rim may show.

assistant.name: AltiBot
assistant.formerName: The brand kit's files still use the robot's earlier name; the owner renamed it AltiBot on 2026-11-22. Same art.
assistant.role: Credalti's AI assistant, always identified as AI
assistant.look: A friendly robot: gold and cream shell, navy body, glowing amber face, a checkmark on his chest.

team.name: Alti
team.role: The face of Credalti's human team. Never the author of a message, never a particular teammate, never presented as AI.
team.look: A young man in a navy overshirt with the Credalti logo, a lanyard badge reading ALTI, a gold shoulder strap with a checkmark device.

look: Photoreal live-action TV commercial, deadpan comedy, shot on 35mm, late-afternoon golden light, locked-off camera on a tripod, natural film grain.

voice.direction: Mexican Spanish, warm friendly adult male voice with gentle deadpan humor, natural conversational pace.
voice.note: The video model invents the voice on every render, so it differs between videos. It could not be locked from the approved ad: cloning a voice needs 10 seconds or more of clear speech, the approved take has about 4.5, and the three takes made so far are three different voices. To lock it: pick the take whose voice is right (or a preset voice), record one line of 10+ seconds in it, create the voice, then run every new clip through voice change before assembly.

endCard.logo: public/brand/logo/credalti-logo-white.svg, the kit's file as is, on brand navy #12213A with the gold #EFB537 swoosh. Never a typeset wordmark, never a score gauge.
